clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
as President of the United States and as 
Commander in Chief of the Army and 
Navy, it is ordered that Executive Order 
9074 of February 25, 1942, directing the 
Secretary of the Navy to take action nec­
essary to protect vessels, harbors, ports 
and waterfront facilities, be, and it is 
hereby revoked.
